conflicts.quote: A date the set does **not** name, or a holiday answer that **cannot be evaluated**, is **not** classified as a known full-day holiday.
conflicts.why: Unlisted ≠ holiday is lock 2 and I still hold it. 'Cannot be evaluated' is not a membership outcome. The table is compile-time `&'static` triples: lookup on a parsed NaiveDate is total, never Result, never a missing file. A plantable 'unreadable set' requires a runtime calendar. A Result that fail-opens occupancy to a due weekday fabricates session-day holes; a Result that fail-closes fabricates empty-expected holiday. Both fight absent-is-not-none. Clock/zone/et_date garbage already maps to CoverageFault::UnparseableDate.
conflicts.proposal: Split the sentence. Dates not in the set, including outside 2020..=2032, are not holidays (Mon–Fri stays a session weekday). Unparseable et_date/clock stays existing coverage-failed / UnparseableDate. Membership stays `fn(NaiveDate) -> bool` with no Err. Scanner has no lookup Err to fail-open; SCAN_MARKET_HOURS_ONLY off remains the inherited sweep-anyway path. Drop GATE Q's planted unreadable set.

conflicts.quote: Under AC-1’s preconditions, coverage’s operator-visible reason is **holiday**, not weekend.
conflicts.why: Coverage HTTP has no reason field today. Weekend empty-expected is already generic (NO EXPECTED IDENTITIES — it does not say weekend). Requiring an operator-visible holiday reason on coverage forces a new coverage key, a sixth cell, or a framing rewrite. UX forbids all three, and lock 3 already picked same due-ness / distinct internal arm, not a new coverage print. Distinguishability of Thursday vs Saturday belongs on the occupancy/identity arm and on tape/keep sibling prints.
conflicts.proposal: Coverage holiday D uses the same empty-expected envelope as Sat/Sun (not_due, no-expected framing, expected_due 0, empty rows/holes). CoverageMatrix.weekend stays Sat/Sun only; the envelope keys no-expected framing off !is_et_session_day, not by setting weekend true. Tape/keep print ineligible-holiday vs ineligible-weekend. Poison holiday-as-weekend on those vehicles. No coverage cell and no new coverage HTTP reason token this slice.

conflicts.quote: Architect inverts the keep oracle `holiday_weekday_zero_rows_is_empty_extract_not_weekend`: after this feature, holiday D is ineligible, **not** `Occupancy::EmptyExtract`.
conflicts.why: That test's D is 2026-08-10, a Monday that is not a NYSE full-day holiday (UX's own ordinary-weekday oracle). Inverting it in place would mark a session weekday ineligible and fight the out-set pin plus PM AC-29. The test name documents today's hole — any weekday zero-row gzip is EmptyExtract because no calendar exists. The date is a stand-in, not Thanksgiving.
conflicts.proposal: Leave holiday_weekday_zero_rows_is_empty_extract_not_weekend on 2026-08-10 as EmptyExtract / !is_et_weekend / not IneligibleWeekend. Add a new fixture on a real in-set weekday (2026-11-26 Thanksgiving) that gates before GET, stores nothing, and is not EmptyExtract / not Miss / not IneligibleWeekend.

conflicts.quote: Forbidden edges: tape/keep ↛ coverage/ensure; calendar ↛ `quant-engine` / `signals`; calendar ↛ Massive REST/WS/files; FE ↛ a second holiday table.
conflicts.why: The last clause over-claimed. marketSessionPhase is an existing weekend gate (Sat/Sun → closed; 2026-08-10 10:00 ET → rth). If SSE market_session is closed and the scanner badge stays RTH, the desk has two answers for the same D. A hand-maintained independent TS calendar is still the drift failure I named; forbidding any dashboard membership left that clock with no mechanism.
conflicts.proposal: Retract only 'FE ↛ a second holiday table'. Canonical closed set stays the Rust domain module. Dashboard marketSessionPhase consumes a generated or pin-equality-tested replica of that same set, used only by the scanner session badge. No GET /api/holidays, no bundle calendar field, no calendar UI. Ticker chip still binds SSE market_session === 'closed', not the replica. quant-engine / Massive / tape↛coverage edges stand.

conflicts.quote: On holiday D at 10:00 ET the chip must see `live: false` and `market_session: 'closed'` so `liveStatus` takes the closed branch.
conflicts.why: live is tick-age freshness (tick_age < LIVE_TICK_MAX_AGE_S), not session standing. liveStatus returns the live chip whenever live.live is true, before it reads market_session — so live true + closed paints '● live · closed'. Forcing live false is the calendar writing a tick flag. Holiday ClosedPre / closed is a static session clock, not an SSE-drop degrade, and must not reuse the no-ticks path as its mechanism.
conflicts.proposal: market_session_at returns closed on a full-day holiday (lock 4). Leave live as tick-age. Reorder liveStatus so market_session === 'closed' wins over the live.live short-circuit (never ● live · closed). The calendar does not write live: false.

conflicts.quote: Frontend copy, layout, or a client-side holiday list.

BRIEF: vehicles that already have a weekend gate consume the holiday answer. Ticker-closed via the two server classifiers is necessary and not sufficient for scanner chrome. I will not silently drop it.
conflicts.proposal: Keep FE copy and layout in UX’s lane. Treat the existing dashboard session-phase clock as a consumer of the one in-process membership — generated or shared, not hand-copied, not `GET /api/holidays`, not a new SSE/bundle field. Holiday D at 10:00 ET shows Closed, not RTH, same as Saturday. Owner may cut this only explicitly.

conflicts.quote: Under AC-1’s preconditions, coverage’s operator-visible reason is **holiday**, not weekend.

UX’s coverage chrome is already class-level no-expected identities and does not say weekend; forcing a holiday reason on that card adds a sixth cell, a holiday name line, or a new key the card must learn this slice — all rejected. Distinguishability of Thursday vs Saturday lives on tape/keep sibling literals and on not printing weekend on a holiday weekday.
conflicts.proposal: Coverage HTTP/UI uses the same no-expected envelope as weekend: empty rows, not three cells, not a pass, no holiday cell, no holiday name. It must not print weekend on a holiday Thursday. Tape/keep print ineligible holiday, not ineligible weekend (AC-13/16/43). Poison holiday-as-weekend still goes red.

conflicts.quote: When the holiday answer cannot be evaluated, coverage does **not** print empty-expected holiday; the operator sees **coverage failed / unavailable**, distinct from not-due holiday and from three missing cells as the only signal.
conflicts.why: SELF-REVISION — I withdraw serve-time “set unreadable / holiday answer cannot be evaluated” as a holiday-specific class. Architect’s compiled table is total on a parsed date: never `Result`, never null, never a missing file at serve. Inventing a holiday-unknown path would either fabricate empty-expected (hides a hole) or fight fail-closed occupancy. I also withdraw AC-34 as a holiday-lookup-`Err` scanner path.
conflicts.proposal: Unlisted dates, including outside 2020..=2032, are not holidays (session weekdays). Invalid `et_date` / zone parse stays on the existing unparseable / coverage-failed arms — not empty-expected holiday. Scanner fail-open remains gate-off (`SCAN_MARKET_HOURS_ONLY` false), same as weekend, not a new lookup-failure idle. Corrupt table is compile/test red, not a serve fallback.

conflicts.quote: For the same market inputs, opportunity score, tier, and state fingerprint are **byte-identical** with this construct present vs absent and with D a holiday vs a session weekday that happens to carry the same inputs.

Honest `ClosedPre` / `closed` on a full-day holiday changes spot selection versus today’s false RTH at 10:00 ET. Requiring Thanksgiving’s score to match a session Tuesday either forbids the session-standing fix or pretends phase is not an input. `Authorizes: nothing` means do not retune the formula and do not feed the calendar into `generate_signals`.

Do not require a holiday weekday’s output to equal a session weekday’s output when standing is correctly closed vs RTH.
